verses.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
verses.pt: Filho do homem, dize ao príncipe de Tiro: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que teu coração se exalta, e dizes: Eu sou um deus; no trono de de Deus me sento no meio dos mares (sendo tu homem e não Deus); e consideras teu coração como coração de Deus;
verses.en_web: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and not God, though you set your heart as the heart of God—
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, This is what the Lord has said: Because your heart has been lifted up, and you have said, I am a god, I am seated on the seat of God in the heart of the seas; but you are man and not God, though you have made your heart as the heart of God:

verses.en: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
verses.pt: (Eis que tu és mais sábio que Daniel; não há segredo algum que possa se esconder de ti;
verses.en_web: behold, you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that is hidden from you;
verses.en_bbe: See, you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret which is deeper than your knowledge:

verses.en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
verses.pt: Com tua sabedoria e teu entendimento obtiveste riquezas, e adquiriste ouro e prata em teus tesouros;
verses.en_web: by your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasures;
verses.en_bbe: By your wisdom and deep knowledge you have got power for yourself, and put silver and gold in your store-houses:

verses.en: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
verses.pt: Com a tua grande sabedoria aumentaste tuas riquezas em teu comércio; e por causa de tuas riquezas teu coração tem se exaltado).
verses.en_web: by your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”
verses.en_bbe: By your great wisdom and by your trade your power is increased, and your heart is lifted up because of your power:

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
verses.pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que consideras teu coração como coração se fosse de Deus,
verses.en_web: “‘therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,
verses.en_bbe: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have made your heart as the heart of God,

verses.en: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
verses.pt: Por isso eis que eu trarei sobre ti estrangeiros, os mais violentos das nações, os quais desembainharão suas espadas contra a beleza de tua sabedoria, e contaminarão o teu resplendor.
verses.en_web: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am sending against you strange men, feared among the nations: they will let loose their swords against your bright wisdom, they will make your glory a common thing.

verses.en: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
verses.pt: À cova te farão descer, e morrerás da morte dos que morrem no meio dos mares.
verses.en_web: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.
verses.en_bbe: They will send you down to the underworld, and your death will be the death of those who are put to the sword in the heart of the seas.

verses.en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
verses.pt: Por acaso dirás: Eu sou Deus, diante de teu matador? Tu és homem, e não Deus, nas mãos de quem te matar.
verses.en_web: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
verses.en_bbe: Will you say, in the face of those who are taking your life, I am God? but you are man and not God in the hands of those who are wounding you.

verses.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: De morte de incircuncisos morrerás, pela mão de estrangeiros; porque assim eu falei, diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.en_web: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
verses.en_bbe: Your death will be the death of those who are without circumcision, by the hands of men from strange lands: for I have said it, says the Lord.

verses.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.pt: Filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre o rei de Tiro, e dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Tu eras o carimbo da perfeição, cheio de sabedoria, e perfeito em formosura.
verses.en_web: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, make a song of grief for the king of Tyre, and say to him, This is what the Lord has said: You are all-wise and completely beautiful;

verses.en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
verses.pt: Estiveste no Éden, o jardim de Deus; toda pedra preciosa era tua cobertura; sárdio, topázio, diamante, turquesa, ônix, jaspe, safira, carbúnculo, e esmeralda; e de ouro era a obra de tuas molduras e de teus engastes em ti; no dia em que foste criado estavam preparados.
verses.en_web: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. They were prepared in the day that you were created.
verses.en_bbe: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every stone of great price was your clothing, the sardius, the topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the emerald and the carbuncle: your store-houses were full of gold, and things of great price were in you; in the day when you were made they were got ready.

verses.en: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.pt: Tu eras querubim ungido, cobridor; e eu te estabeleci, no santo monte de Deus estavas; no meio de pedras de fogo tu andavas.
verses.en_web: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.
verses.en_bbe: I gave you your place with the winged one; I put you on the mountain of God; you went up and down among the stones of fire.

verses.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
verses.pt: Íntegro eras em teus caminhos, desde o dia em que foste criado, até que se achou maldade em ti.
verses.en_web: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.
verses.en_bbe: There has been no evil in your ways from the day when you were made, till sin was seen in you.

verses.en: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.pt: Pela abundância de teu comércio encheram o meio de ti de violência; por isso eu te expulsei como profanado do monte de Deus, e te farei perecer, ó querubim cobridor, do meio das pedras de fogo.
verses.en_web: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence, and you have sinned. Therefore I have cast you as profane out of God’s mountain. I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.
verses.en_bbe: Through all your trading you have become full of violent ways, and have done evil: so I sent you out shamed from the mountain of God; the winged one put an end to you from among the stones of fire.

verses.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
verses.pt: Teu coração se exaltou por causa de tua formosura, corrompeste tua sabedoria por causa de teu resplendor; eu te lancei por terra; diante dos reis eu te pus, para que olhem para ti.
verses.en_web: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty. You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I have cast you to the ground. I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.
verses.en_bbe: Your heart was lifted up because you were beautiful, you made your wisdom evil through your sin: I have sent you down, even to the earth; I have made you low before kings, so that they may see you.

verses.en: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
verses.pt: Por causa da multidão de tuas maldades e da perversidade de teu comércio, profanaste teus santuários; por isso eu fiz sair um fogo do meio de ti, o qual te consumiu; e te tornei em cinza sobre a terra, diante dos olhos de todos quantos te veem.
verses.en_web: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your commerce, you have profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you. It has devoured you. I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.
verses.en_bbe: By all your sin, even by your evil trading, you have made your holy places unclean; so I will make a fire come out from you, it will make a meal of you, and I will make you as dust on the earth before the eyes of all who see you.

verses.en: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
verses.pt: Todos os que te conhecem entre os povos estão espantados por causa de ti; em grande horror te tornaste, e nunca mais voltarás a existir.
verses.en_web: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you. You have become a terror, and you will exist no more.”’”
verses.en_bbe: All who have knowledge of you among the peoples will be overcome with wonder at you: you have become a thing of fear, and you will never be seen again.

verses.en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.pt: Filho do homem, dirige teu rosto contra Sidom, e profetiza contra ela;
verses.en_web: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, let your face be turned to Zidon, and be a prophet against it, and say,

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
verses.pt: E dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu sou contra ti, ó Sidom, e serei glorificado no meio de ti; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando nela fizer juízos, e nela me santificar.
verses.en_web: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Behold, I am against you, Sidon. I will be glorified among you. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have executed judgments in her, and am sanctified in her.
verses.en_bbe: These are the words of the Lord: See, I am against you, O Zidon; and I will get glory for myself in you: and they will be certain that I am the Lord, when I send my punishments on her, and I will be seen to be holy in her.

verses.en: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her street; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Pois enviarei a ela pestilência e sangue em suas ruas; e mortos cairão no meio dela pela espada que está contra ela ao redor; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets. The wounded will fall within her, with the sword on her on every side. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And I will send on her disease and blood in her streets; and the wounded will be falling in the middle of her, and the sword will be against her on every side; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

verses.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: E a casa de Israel nunca mais terá espinho que a fira, nem abrolho que cause dor, de todos os que desprezam ao redor deles; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
verses.en_web: “‘“There will be no more a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: And there will no longer be a plant with sharp points wounding the children of Israel, or a thorn troubling them among any who are round about them, who put shame on them; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Quando eu ajuntar a casa de Israel dos povos entre os quais estão dispersos, e eu me santificar entre eles diante dos olhos das nações, então habitarão em sua terra, que dei a meu servo Jacó.
verses.en_web: “‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am sanctified in them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: When I have got together the children of Israel from the peoples among whom they are wandering, and have been made holy among them before the eyes of the nations, then they will have rest in the land which is theirs, which I gave to my servant Jacob

verses.en: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.
verses.pt: E habitarão nela em segurança, edificarão casas, e plantarão vinhas; e habitarão em segurança, quando eu fizer juízos contra todos os que os desprezam ao redor deles; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, o Deus deles.
verses.en_web: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely, when I have executed judgments on all those who scorn them all around. Then they will know that I am Yahweh their God.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And they will be safe there, building houses and planting vine-gardens and living without fear; when I have sent my punishments on all those who put shame on them round about them; and they will be certain that I am the Lord their God.
